scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @loja/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @loja/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @loja/api && npm run build -w @loja/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npx tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
